purpose: Forensically map current Creative Excellence, Prose System and Book Evaluator capabilities into professional structural-edit, stylistic/line-edit, copy-edit and post-layout-proofread responsibilities before any new editor capability is built.
governing_reuse_law: Creative Excellence 012-019 supplies recovered granular craft, reader-state, revision-experimentation and whole-book assurance authorities.
Prose A-L supplies governed analysis, diagnosis, craft retrieval, bounded revision, independent comparison, preference learning and homogenization defense.
Book Evaluator supplies independent diagnostic/comparison/qualification evidence and has no canonical-write authority.
Book System parent owns lifecycle stage, canonical state, version admission, author decisions and publication/export authority.
A new engine is forbidden when an existing authority can satisfy the responsibility through a parent-visible stage/interface contract.

existing_primary_owners: Creative Excellence 017/018 whole-book synthesis, contradictions and hard gates
Prose canonical narrative state and global narrative orchestration
Book Evaluator STRUCTURE_CAUSAL and CONTINUITY_STATE evidence
existing_execution_evidence: Narrative State / Narrative Orchestration contracts and qualification lineage
STRUCTURAL_EDIT_REVIEW.parent_interface_gap: The parent lifecycle has STRUCTURAL_REVIEW but lacks an explicit research-verified stage contract that binds entry evidence, exit criteria, transitive narrative-consistency regression and downstream invalidation.
STRUCTURAL_EDIT_REVIEW.required_parent_action: Add/replace the generic STRUCTURAL_REVIEW transition with a versioned STRUCTURAL_EDIT_REVIEW gate that requests existing services and records evidence; do not build another structural editor.
STRUCTURAL_EDIT_REVIEW.author_boundary: Material canon/intent/structure changes remain AUTHOR_REQUIRED where configured by the parent lifecycle.

existing_primary_owners: Book Evaluator SURFACE_LANGUAGE and REVISION_ASSESSMENT evidence
STYLISTIC_OR_LINE_EDIT_REVIEW.parent_interface_gap: Parent lifecycle uses PROSE_REFINEMENT but does not explicitly distinguish the professional line/stylistic stage or bind its entry/exit evidence to the existing Prose editorial packet vocabulary.
STYLISTIC_OR_LINE_EDIT_REVIEW.bounded_refinement: Add author-workshop/craft-calibration evidence mode to the existing Craft Academy / author-review path: authorized/public-domain close reading, craft-objective critique, revision rationale/intended reader effect, sentence/form practice, and author accept/reject learning.
STYLISTIC_OR_LINE_EDIT_REVIEW.required_parent_action: Create STYLISTIC_OR_LINE_EDIT_REVIEW as a parent stage wrapper over existing Prose/Creative Excellence services; no replacement line editor.

existing_primary_owners: Book Evaluator SURFACE_LANGUAGE evidence: grammar, fragments, dialect, repetition and minor style issues
Book Evaluator FACT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE: factual claims, quote attribution, source-support conflicts and unsupported assertions
Prose preservation specialists for meaning, canon, voice and protected language
Prose editorial review packet COPY routing metadata
true_gap: parent-owned copy-edit stage contract and entry/exit criteria
versioned project/book style-sheet authority and exception handling
mechanics/usage consistency profile conditioned by genre/audience/project conventions
correction-only boundary that prevents copy editing from silently becoming developmental rewriting
post-copyedit regression confirming no meaning/canon/voice/protected-language damage and no unresolved required queries
COPY_EDIT_REVIEW.required_parent_action: Define a bounded COPY_EDIT_REVIEW contract/profile that orchestrates existing diagnostics/evaluator evidence plus a versioned style sheet. Build only missing orchestration/consistency checks, not a new literary editor or evaluator.
COPY_EDIT_REVIEW.human_or_author_boundary: Ambiguous, intentional, voice-sensitive, fact-disputed, permissions-sensitive or canon-affecting changes must escalate under existing review/author rules.

existing_reuse: Book Evaluator / Prose may supply textual spelling/grammar/continuity/preservation evidence where relevant
Prose editorial review packet MECHANICAL routing vocabulary
true_gap: proof against the exact rendered/export candidate rather than pre-layout manuscript text
heading/section/page/TOC/link/navigation integrity as applicable to the medium
missing/duplicated/truncated text detection between frozen manuscript source and rendered artifact
typographic/layout defects and medium-specific presentation anomalies
proof correction ledger bound to exact export-candidate digest
bounded proof-correction re-render and re-proof loop
rule that proofreading cannot silently reopen structural or line editing
POST_LAYOUT_PROOFREAD_REVIEW.required_parent_action: Create a parent production-stage POST_LAYOUT_PROOFREAD_REVIEW gate as part of publication/export closure. It should consume exact rendered artifacts and format-specific validators; it is not a Prose child responsibility.

cross_stage_rules: Stages are responsibility boundaries, not independent projects or universal passes that every book must undergo identically.
Applicability is conditioned by book form, genre, audience, author intent, target medium and publication goal.
A later stage must verify that accepted prior-stage changes were actually applied and that it did not introduce regressions outside its scope.
A later stage may surface an upstream structural/line problem but must route it back to the appropriate stage rather than silently widening its own mutation authority.
All candidate changes remain proposal/evidence until Book System parent admission and any required author decision.
Retain-original remains the default when improvement or preservation safety is not established.
Book Evaluator remains independent evidence/qualification; it is never the parent stage-transition or canonical-write authority.
publication_successor_requirements: EPUB 3.3 profile when EPUB is requested
ONIX 3.1-compatible metadata projection when distribution metadata is required
exact frozen manuscript version -> rendered artifact digest binding
post-layout proof before release freeze closure
publication authorization remains separate from technical export/proof PASS
next_objective_contract: Amend the parent authoring lifecycle as a versioned successor so it explicitly sequences/adjudicates STRUCTURAL_EDIT_REVIEW -> STYLISTIC_OR_LINE_EDIT_REVIEW -> COPY_EDIT_REVIEW -> POST_LAYOUT_PROOFREAD_REVIEW where applicable, binds narrative consistency regression to transitive invalidation, preserves Book System parent authority, and leaves executable Integration Proposal Runtime implementation paused until the remaining research remediation contracts close.
qualification_effect: NONE. This is a research-grounded ownership/capability crosswalk. It does not alter existing exact-SHA A-01 evidence, create human/author decisions, promote manuscript changes, or authorize publication.
